say:0:1623229001:0.text: In a small clearing, a bird nestles beside Sweep's flickering glow, warming her damp feathers with little pleased chirps. Sweep keeps the flame stable with careful focus. The moment feels safe and tender.
say:0:1623229001:0.source_cn: 林间空地上，一只小鸟正依偎在斯威普摇曳的烛光旁烘烤湿漉...

say:2:1623229003:2.text: Candel arrives in a hurry, then lights up at the sight and scampers closer.
say:2:1623229003:2.source_cn: 坎德尔急匆匆地赶来，看到此景，立刻兴奋地凑了上去。

say:4:1623229004:0.text: Hey! Buddy! Look at you! This is—
say:4:1623229004:0.source_cn: 嘿！伙计！真有你的！这简直太——

say:5:1623229005:0.text: Shh... Quiet, Candel. She just calmed down.
say:5:1623229005:0.source_cn: 嘘……坎德尔！小声点，她刚安静下来。

say:6:1623229006:0.text: Candel freezes, then immediately softens to a hush.
say:6:1623229006:0.source_cn: 坎德尔这才意识到，连忙把声音压得极低。

say:7:1623229007:1.text: Wow... She trusts you so much... I knew you'd pull it off!
say:7:1623229007:1.source_cn: 太棒了……她居然这么信任你……我就知道你能行！

say:8:1623229008:0.text: She fell into some water and got spooked. I happened to be here... I'm able to offer a little warmth.
say:8:1623229008:0.source_cn: 她只是不小心掉进了水洼，又冷又怕。我刚好在这里……能提...

say:10:1623229009:0.text: Without any warning at all, a strong wind tears through the clearing. Sweep's flame wobbles wildly, and several blistering drops of wax land on dry pine needles and fallen leaves nearby.
say:10:1623229009:0.source_cn: 然而，恰在此时，一阵林间的强风毫无征兆地刮过！斯威普的...

say:12:1623229010:0.text: Szzzt! With a nasty hiss, orange flames shoot up instantly!
say:12:1623229010:0.source_cn: “嗞——！”刺耳的声响中，橘红色的火苗猛地窜了起来！

say:17:1623229012:0.text: Panic hits. Sweep tries to stomp out the flames with his metal footpads, only to slosh more wax into the fire with every awkward step.
say:17:1623229012:0.source_cn: 场面瞬间大乱！斯威普下意识地想用金属脚掌踩灭火苗，可笨...

say:18:1623229013:0.text: Desperate, Candel swats at the blaze and ends up fanning it like a bellows. The flame then flares.
say:18:1623229013:0.source_cn: 坎德尔情急之下抡起扫把鬃毛奋力拍打，可扇起的风却让火焰...

say:19:1623229014:0.text: The calm from moments ago is completely shattered. Birds take flight, and startled cries from the animals echo from every direction.
say:19:1623229014:0.source_cn: 刚才的宁静被彻底打破，小鸟惊飞，动物们的惊呼声从四面八...
